info.name: Paideia POC - v1 Minimal
info.description: Postman collection for v1/minimal. Infrastructure runs with Docker Compose; business services run on localhost ports 8081-8086.

item.name: Health Checks
item.description: Spring Actuator health endpoints for all v1 services.

item.name: Course Service
item.description: Course catalog. Source of truth for course price and publication status.

item.name: Enrollment Service
item.description: Orchestrates enrollment: course validation, payment processing, notification, and content access check.

item.name: POST /enrollments - ENROLLED
item.description: Uses a PUBLISHED seed course with price below 10000.

item.name: POST /enrollments - course not published
item.description: Expected result: 409 conflict because the course is DRAFT.

item.name: Payment Service
item.description: Simulated payment processing. Amounts >= 10000 are rejected.

item.name: Notification Service
item.description: Persists notification requests. In v4 this becomes a Kafka consumer.
